beats.title: A story begins
narration: Someone left a letter in your pack. Nobody saw who.
It asks you to follow the road and keep quiet.

beats.title: The quiet road
narration: The road into {map:1421,50,50} is quiet. Too quiet.
A cold wind follows you down the road.

beats.title: Not over yet
narration: You fell. Get up. The story is not over.

beats.title: Home again
narration: The road ends in {map:1458,50,50}. Find a warm fire and rest.
The letter was a test, and you passed it.
